prompts.name: home
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: SAGE Open Graph social preview image, finished raster artwork, landscape aspect ratio EXACTLY 1200:630 (1.90476:1), preferably high resolution 2400x1260.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved SAGE brand typography, color and neural-brain reference. Image 2 is the approved website brain artwork and exact visual style reference. Recompose these into a clean social card.
Style: premium luminous sculptural neural brain, lavender and restrained violet over rich near-black plum (#06020e, #110b22), sparse tiny teal (#2dd4bf) nodes, fine sweeping filaments. Calm and precise, matching the approved website.
Composition: ample 7% safe margins on all sides. Left 54% carries crisp text; right 43% carries a complete recognizable lavender brain. Keep filaments very faint behind the words. Small cards must be readable at thumbnail size.
Typography: preserve the distinctive wide geometric SAGE wordmark from image 1, with the angular barless A, rounded S/G and lavender-white fill. Use clean sans-serif for the page headline and subtitle. SAGE appears at upper left, headline beneath it, subtitle near the lower left. Clear size hierarchy; subtitle still legible. No pill badges, browser UI, screenshots, decorative icons, watermark or extra lettering.
Constraints: final layout fills the requested 1200:630 ratio with no borders, no cropped words or cropped brain. Exact supplied text only.
Page: Homepage.
Text (verbatim): "SAGE" / "Stop re-explaining\nyour project." / "Persistent memory for AI agents."
Mood: confident, warm and useful. Make the main message very clear.
